purpose: Versioned, non-PyPSA inputs required to turn system outputs into consumer-bill recovery components. Null means the bridge remains an evidence gap and cannot replace a historical allowance.

cfd.source: Sum LCCC-style CfD difference payments, including reconciliation and levy adjustments; do not use a nodal balancing price.

ro.source: Eligible ROC generation x banding x certificate/buy-out cost, reconciled to supplier obligation recovery.

bsuos.source: Use gross upward plus downward redispatch MWh per MWh demand as a calibrated activity index. Projected allowance = calibration allowance times projected gross-volume intensity divided by calibration intensity. Bid/offer cost remains a separate diagnostic; this is not a direct BSUoS settlement-cost pass-through.

losses.source: Use represented AC transmission losses only as a calibrated index of the published supplier-loss allowance. Supplier regional and distribution loss factors remain external inputs.

imbalance.source: Use a separately calibrated gross redispatch-volume intensity for the imbalance allowance, then validate against cash-out and balancing settlement. Do not combine this with BSUoS.

capacity_market.source: Capacity Market auction/recovery forecast; peak demand alone is not a consumer levy.

tnuos.source: NESO allowed-revenue and TNUoS charging allocation, informed by network build but not derived from power flows.

duos_fixed.source: DNO allowed revenue and charging allocation for fixed recovery.

duos_unit.source: DNO allowed revenue and charging allocation for volumetric recovery.

fit.source: Use FiT-labelled generation with published tariff and levelisation inputs. Do not infer FiT payments from merchant renewable generation.
